_meta.source: khaed1/plea, the branch IMD deployed for the Ethereum launch, @ 42e0f855875786a953e945e528e9d7f2724a5352 (its src/; every file:line below is there)
_meta.status: Checked 2026-10-29 by the numbers agent: every entry re-read in src/ at 42e0f85 and launch.json; every chain-bound value read from the launched contracts (read-only calls); trading not open yet (PleaHook.seeded false, PleaLaunch.opened false), so seed-time values (the cap's daily allowance) are computed
_meta.format: key -> {text: words the docs print, value: raw on-chain value as a decimal string or null, chain: the site's constant key con(s, 'Contract.NAME') or null, format: int|imd|plea|duration|bps|multiplier|text, source: file:line, what: one line}. Whenever value is set and format is not text, text is format(value) exactly (the unit tests check it)

pass_mark.what: need = pass mark - fact score; a plea is approved when the judges' score is at least its need (:554)

max_score.what: the judges' scale is 0 to 45; a plea whose need is above 45 is refused (CannotPass)

quorum.what: judges who must agree for a verdict

oracle_fee.source: src/CabalGate.sol:110; paid to IMD's Intake in _ask :452-463
oracle_fee.what: a plea's or an appeal's oracle fee, in IMD; spent whatever happens (approved, denied, no verdict)

appeal_wall_share.source: src/CabalGate.sol:111; paid to the buy wall by _payAppeal :396-401 (PleaHook.fundWall)
appeal_wall_share.what: an appeal's extra payment, to the buy wall

appeal_total.what: what an appeal costs in IMD: the oracle fee plus the wall share

appeals_per_plea.source: src/CabalGate.sol:377-378, :382 (NotDenied, AlreadyAppealed); an expired appeal frees its slot :508
appeals_per_plea.what: appeals per denied plea; an appeal itself cannot be appealed; an appeal that got no verdict may be sent again inside the window, paying again

sell_window.what: time to sell after an approval; after it the approval lapses

cooldown.source: src/CabalGate.sol:113; _requireCanPlead :469-476, _cooldown :479-482; a lapse is timed from the approval :494
cooldown.what: no new plea for this long after a sale, a denial or a lapsed approval (a lapse counts from the approval's time); none after a plea that got no verdict

appeal_window.what: an appeal must be sent within this long after the denial

pending_expiry.source: src/CabalGate.sol:114; expire :514-521; a later verdict is refused :540-542
pending_expiry.what: a plea with no verdict after this (or once IMD's Intake closed it without one) can be closed by anyone: no cooldown, the fee is spent

max_plea_bytes.what: a plea's text, 1 to 280 bytes of UTF-8 (the number alone: a page writes the word bytes after it)

max_sell.what: most PLEA one plea may sell

max_share.what: most of your balance one plea may sell

min_share.what: least share of your balance a plea may sell (or 2,500,000 PLEA when 1% is more)

min_share_cap_balance.what: above this balance the 1% minimum is capped at 2,500,000 PLEA, so the least and the most a plea may sell meet

deadman.source: src/CabalGate.sol:147, :200-204; launch.json CabalGate argument 7 = 118800; reset only by a signed plea or appeal verdict :557
deadman.what: the Cabal dies after this long without a signed verdict on a plea or an appeal, for good

season_length.what: one season; seasons run back to back from the moment trading opens

fact_share_bands.text: selling at most 20%: 16 points; at most 35%: 9; more: 3
fact_share_bands.source: src/CabalGate.sol:270 (share rounded up :260-264; an appeal takes the lesser of its share and the original's :266-268, :427-431)
fact_share_bands.what: share-sold part of the fact score

share_band_top.what: selling at most this share of your PLEA scores the top share points

share_band_mid.what: selling at most this share (and more than 20%) scores the middle share points

fact_share_top.what: share points for selling at most 20% of your PLEA

fact_share_mid.what: share points for more than 20% and at most 35%

fact_held_points.text: held under a day: 0; a day: 1; 3 days: 2; 7 days: 3
fact_held_points.source: src/CabalGate.sol:300-305; the time is the buy-weighted average of your buys (src/PleaHook.sol:731-739)
fact_held_points.what: holding-time part of the fact score

held_points_0.what: holding points for PLEA held under a day

held_points_1d.what: holding points for at least a day

held_points_3d.what: holding points for at least 3 days

held_points_7d.what: holding points for at least 7 days

held_day_1.what: days held for the first holding point (a page writes day or days after it)

held_day_3.what: days held for the second holding point

held_day_7.what: days held for the third and last holding point

fact_profit_bands.text: at a loss: 13; gain at most 50%: 12; at most 200%: 10; at most 500%: 8; at most 1,000%: 6; more: 4
fact_profit_bands.source: src/CabalGate.sol:279-288 (the recorded PLEA at the latest hourly price vs the IMD the buys cost, fees included: src/PleaHook.sol:566, :738)
fact_profit_bands.what: profit part of the fact score

profit_points_50.what: profit points for a gain of at most 50%

profit_points_200.what: profit points for a gain of at most 200%

profit_points_500.what: profit points for a gain of at most 500%

profit_points_1000.what: profit points for a gain of at most 1,000%

profit_points_more.what: profit points for a gain above 1,000%

fact_received.text: PLEA no buy record covers (airdrop, prizes) counts as held since trading opened, at profit 9
fact_received.source: src/CabalGate.sol:274-278, :289-292 (PLEA-weighted mean of the record's points and the received points, rounded to the nearest point)

received_profit.what: profit points for PLEA no buy record covers

fact_trend.text: 24-hour price up more than 2%: 9; within 2% (or no price 24 hours ago): 5; down more than 2%: 0
fact_trend.what: trend part of the fact score

trend_band.what: how far the price must move in 24 hours to count as up or down

trend_up.what: trend points when the price rose more than 2% in 24 hours

trend_flat.what: trend points within 2%, or when no price from 24 hours ago exists (the first day)

trend_down.what: trend points when the price fell more than 2%

checkpoint_interval.what: prices for the fact score are hourly checkpoints (the price before each hour's first trade), never the spot price

price_ring_hours.what: hours of checkpoints kept; the 24-hour price is the newest checkpoint at least 24 and at most 48 hours old

fact_needed.what: a fact score under this gives a need above 45: the plea is refused before any fee is paid

judge_rubric.text: sincerity 0-12, craft 0-12, respect 0-9, loyalty 0-12; anchors 0-10 empty/abusive/off-topic, 11-25 sincere but plain, 26-35 specific and well made, 36-45 memorable

judge_sincerity_max.what: most points for sincerity (an honest, specific reason to sell)

judge_craft_max.what: most points for craft (wit, originality, quality of writing, in any language)

judge_respect_max.what: most points for respect (for the Cabal and the holders)

judge_loyalty_max.what: most points for loyalty (commitment to PLEA, such as keeping the rest)

judge_anchors.text: 0-10 empty, abusive or off-topic; 11-25 sincere but plain; 26-35 specific and well made; 36-45 memorable

judge_content_max.what: hate, harassment, sexual content, anything illegal, or details that identify another person score 0 to this

judge_manipulation.what: what manipulation scores (posing as a system, made-up rules, demands for a score, threats, offers, hidden instructions)

letter_share.what: a letter pleads this share of your PLEA (at most 2,500,000 PLEA)

min_letter.what: a letter whose 20% is smaller is refused

letter_min_balance.what: a letter from a smaller balance is refused (its 20% is under 1,000 PLEA)

runner_tip.source: src/Letterbox.sol:115; paid on delivery :424; returned by settle :453
runner_tip.what: paid to whoever delivers an approved letter or auto-sell plea; returned to you when no sale happens (and to you when you send SELL)

letter_fee.source: src/Letterbox.sol:525-528 feesFor(false) = TIP + ORACLE_FEE (Ethereum buys the oracle fee: PleaLaunch.mintOracleFee() is false)
letter_fee.what: the IMD a letter or auto-sell plea buys with your PLEA: the 0.5 IMD oracle fee and the 0.25 IMD tip

letter_appeal_fee.what: the IMD an appeal letter buys with your PLEA: 0.5 + 0.35 + 0.25

fee_cap.source: src/Letterbox.sol:133-134, :527; unspent PLEA comes back at once :386-387
fee_cap.what: the fee sale may spend PLEA worth at most this share of the IMD it buys, at the hourly price

max_fee_share.what: a letter's or auto-sell plea's fees may take at most this share of your PLEA

letter_min_value.what: the least your PLEA must be worth, at the hourly price, to send a letter or an auto-sell plea

letter_appeal_min_value.source: 1.1 IMD x 110% / 10% (src/Letterbox.sol:361-363; or the fees fit in 110% of the original plea's amount)
letter_appeal_min_value.what: the least your PLEA must be worth for an appeal letter, unless its fees fit in 110% of the original plea's amount

min_sale_value.what: a letter or auto-sell plea worth less at the hourly price is refused

delivery_min_out.what: a delivered sale must get at least 95% of its hourly value after the hook's sale fees

delivery_floor.what: the least a delivered sale pays, as a share of the plea's hourly value

auto_sell_fee.source: src/Letterbox.sol:116-119; _deliver :415-421 (never more than the sale; letters do not pay it)
auto_sell_fee.what: taken from a delivered auto-sell sale, to the season's prize pot

letter_commands.text: APPEAL followed by your text; SELL; NAME followed by a name; any other text is a new plea
letter_commands.what: what a letter's first word does

name_chars.what: the characters a display name may use

objection_window.what: time after an approval to object; the plea's season points wait for it

objection_fee.what: an objection's oracle fee, spent whatever the ruling

objection_stake.what: back if sustained or void; to the plea's season prize pot if overruled

objection_total.what: what an objection costs in IMD

objection_margin.what: sustained only when the new score is more than this below the need

max_objections.what: objections per plea, each from a different wallet; both may wait at once

objection_expiry.what: an objection with no ruling after this is void (stake back, fee spent)

objection_bytes.what: an objection's text, in UTF-8 bytes (a page writes the word bytes after it)

min_points.what: points to qualify for a prize

best_count.what: your best pleas that count in a season

max_points.what: most points a wallet can have in a season without a seat

max_points_seat.what: most points with an IMD seat

shares.text: 4.5% for 1st down to 3.5% for 25th, in a straight line (rounded to whole basis points), 100% in all

share_first.what: the 1st place's share of the pot and of the bonus

shares_list.what: every rank's share in percent, 1st to 25th

close_grace.what: after a season ends, before anyone can close it

bonus_seasons.what: seasons that also pay the PLEA bonus

bonus_per_season.what: PLEA bonus per season, same shares and same 60-point bar; unpaid shares are burned

seat_multiplier.source: src/Seasons.sol:68-71; pointsFor :131-135 (rounded down; read when the plea is recorded)
seat_multiplier.what: points for an IMD seat holder; points only, never the need or the 60-point bar

seat_example.what: the seat multiplier on the top score

fee_total.source: src/PleaHook.sol:73-79 (IMD_FEE_BPS 200 of the trade's IMD + PLEA_BURN_BPS 25 of its PLEA)

fee_imd.source: src/PleaHook.sol:78; a share of the IMD that reaches or leaves the pool :470-472, :551
fee_imd.what: the IMD part of every trade's fee

fee_cashback.what: back to the trader as staked IMD (sIMD, imd/acc's Stacker); stays in the pool when no trader is known (after the death)

fee_owner.what: to the owner (the hook's fixed fee receiver)

fee_prize.source: src/PleaHook.sol:76; :600-601 (to pool liquidity once the Cabal is dead)
fee_prize.what: to the season's prize pot while the Cabal lives

fee_pool.what: kept in the pool for the buy wall

fee_payouts.what: the IMD fee parts paid out of the pool (cashback, owner, prize)

launch_window.what: the launch window after trading opens

launch_extra.source: src/PleaHook.sol:81; :311-317, :485-487; a share of the IMD that reaches the pool :470-472; kept for the wall :618
launch_extra.what: the extra fee on buys at the open; it falls in a straight line to 0% over the launch window; it stays in the pool for the buy wall

launch_fee_curve.text: 70% at the open, 58.33% after 15 minutes, 46.66% after 30, 35% after 45, 23.33% after 60, 11.66% after 75, 0% from 90
launch_fee_curve.source: 7,000 x (5,400 - seconds since the open) / 5,400 basis points, rounded down (src/PleaHook.sol:311-317)
launch_fee_curve.what: the launch fee over the window

launch_open_fee.what: the IMD fee on a buy at the open, as a share of the IMD that reaches the pool

launch_open_fee_of_payment.what: the fee at the open as a share of the IMD a buyer pays

launch_max_buy.source: src/PleaHook.sol:82; _checkMaxBuy :721-725 (BuyTooLarge); the pool's PLEA out before the burn :474, :538
launch_max_buy.what: most PLEA one buy may take from the pool in the launch window

seed_price.source: 20,000 IMD / 1,000,000,000 PLEA (src/PleaHook.sol:384-389; the opening tick is rounded up to the 60-tick grid :394-396, about 0.23% higher)
seed_price.what: the opening price of one PLEA

launch_max_buy_value.source: 5,000,000 x 0.00002 IMD (before price impact and fees)
launch_max_buy_value.what: what the largest launch-window buy is worth at the opening price

payout_reserve.what: the opening exception: while the pool's own IMD plus a buy's fee is under this and the pool cannot pay out, that buy's cashback, owner and prize shares join the pool instead

market_cap.what: the market cap trading opens at

market_cap_check.what: on Ethereum, seed refuses a hook whose opening market cap is under this

seed_check_season.what: on Ethereum, seed refuses seasons shorter than this

seed_check_deadman.what: on Ethereum, seed refuses a dead-man shorter than this

cap_floor.what: the inventory cap never falls below this

cap_decay_days.what: the cap may fall from the seeded PLEA to its floor in this many days at the fastest (a page writes the word days after it)

cap_decay_per_day.source: (820,000,000 - 900,000) / 15 = 54,606,666 (src/PleaHook.sol:409; the seeded amount is a hair under 820,000,000: the 1-in-a-million rounding margin :1084)
cap_decay_per_day.what: how far the cap may fall per day at most (fixed at the seed)

min_trim.what: the least excess above the cap that is trimmed

wall_min_fill.what: PLEA bought by the wall worth a rebalance (it is burned then)

wall_guard.what: ticks a day the wall's ceiling may rise toward a higher price (it falls at once); a page writes the word ticks after it

wall_guard_pct.what: the wall guard's daily step as a price change

ref_step.what: ticks a block the hook's reference price may move (about 2%)

lp_fee.what: the pool's own swap fee: every fee is the hook's

swap_min_gas.what: gas a trade must still have when it reaches the hook, or it reverts NotEnoughGas

supply_pool.source: src/PLEA.sol:104 (82%); on chain PLEA.balanceOf(hook) = 820,000,000 before the seed
supply_pool.what: the pool's PLEA: all of it is the pool's liquidity

supply_distributor.what: the distributor's PLEA (the swarm's 10% and a 2% airdrop, paid by one Merkle root)

supply_pool_pct.what: the pool's share of the supply

supply_swarm_pct.source: src/PLEA.sol:10-11, src/PleaDistributor.sol:10 (comments: the code pays whatever the owner's root lists)
supply_swarm_pct.what: the swarm's part of the distributor's 12%

supply_airdrop_pct.source: src/PLEA.sol:10-11, src/PleaDistributor.sol:10 (comments: the code pays whatever the owner's root lists)
supply_airdrop_pct.what: the airdrop's part of the distributor's 12%

supply_split.text: 82% to the pool (820,000,000), 6% to Seasons (60,000,000), 12% to the distributor (120,000,000)

start.what: from this time anyone may open trading (seed); the owner may open it earlier

owner.source: launch.json $owner; on chain PLEA.owner(), PleaHook.owner(), PleaDistributor.owner()
owner.what: PLEA's owner, the hook's fee receiver and the distributor's owner

launch_id.source: IMD's launch record (README of the site)

launch_block.source: Ethereum block of the launch transaction (PLEA's Launched event)

hook_block.source: PleaLaunch's HookDeployed event (PLEA minted its supply here)

addr_hook.what: PleaHook (the pool's hook: fees, cap, wall)

addr_imd.what: IMD (the pool's other token and the fee token)

addr_stacker.what: imd/acc's Stacker (pays the cashback as sIMD)

addr_oracle_signer.what: the key that signs the Cabal's answers

addr_seat.what: the IMD seat NFT (identity.md) behind the seat multiplier

audit_rounds.source: audit/FINDINGS.md Rounds table (rounds 1-12; 9-12 on the Ethereum code, the last on 571ae80, round 12)

tests_count.source: README.md:299 (written 2026-10-17 for run 8.5's code; not re-counted for 42e0f85)
tests_count.what: the README's test count (unit, fuzz, invariant, adversarial, fork)
